name: The replay slows down around a cut and the director cuts to the close-up (signed in)
description: Validates the replay clock's slow-down from 6 minutes before a cut to 2 minutes after it (30 times slower) and the director's cut to the close-up at C-Lion1 (16:44 UTC), with the countdown to the next event while playing.

planSteps.description: In the sign-in form (data-testid account-form), type testsprite@example.com in the Email field and cabletrace-testsprite-2026 in the Password field, then click Sign in
Wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?t=2024-12-25T16:30Z and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "16:30 UTC" and the Director button (data-testid director-toggle) has data-state "off", since the link names a moment
Click the Director button, then click the button labelled "Play replay" (data-testid replay-play) and wait 5 seconds
Assert the replay clock reads a time from 16:38 to 16:44 UTC (at normal speed it would be past 18:00 by now) and the anchor status (data-testid replay-anchor-status) contains "next event in"
Wait up to 15 seconds until "At the cut" is pressed in the view switch (data-testid view-switch), then click "Pause replay"
Assert "At the cut" is pressed in the view switch and the replay clock reads "16:44 UTC", "16:45 UTC" or "16:46 UTC"
